articles.description:
How To Learn Golf So Fast It Feels Illegal


Danny Maude flips the script on overthinking your swing by teaching you to “have the right conversation” with your clubhead—so you hit your driver dead-straight, strike irons more consistently and add effortless power. By shifting your focus away from mechanics and back into control, you’ll stop slicing, swing more inside-out and nail the correct impact position every time.
This lesson packs simple, take-to-the-range drills and a step-by-step practice plan that works for rookies and seasoned players alike. Plus, Danny’s free YouTube tips, newsletter and community support mean you’ll never practice solo—just subscribe, jump in, screw up, practice some more, and watch your scores tumble.
Watch on YouTube
